subject: 42 Fulbright Street Car Wash Reconstruction
overview: The board approved a special permit for the renovation and vertical expansion of a car wash on Fulbright Street. Other agenda items involving variances for a residential structure and a high-security fence were continued to future meetings.

items.title: 290 Salem Street
items.summary: Continued the petition to construct a seven-unit residential structure with commercial space to the next meeting at the applicant's request.

items.title: 277 Middlesex Avenue
items.summary: Continued the request to expand a non-conforming car wash to the next meeting at the applicant's request.

items.title: 436 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Continued the hearing for a 10-foot high fence variance to October 26 following a debate over security plan requirements and the police chief's refusal to certify such plans.

items.title: 42 Fulbright Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit for the reconstruction and vertical extension of an existing car wash after voting to waive the requirement for a traffic impact study.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the August meeting minutes and discussed recent zoning amendments passed by the City Council, including the addition of a second alternate board member.
